    • processJson

      public static JSONObject processJson(String key, String jsonLine)
      Processes a JSON string by normalizing whitespace and validating the object structure. This method processes a JSON string by:
      1. Replacing all newlines outside of strings with spaces
      2. Trimming leading and trailing whitespace
      3. Validating the resulting string as a JSON object

      The input must represent a valid JSON value containing at least one of the following:

      • String: Characters surrounded by double quotes
      • Number: Number with integer and possible fraction and/or exponent part
      • Object: Key-Value pairs separated by commas, all surrouned by curly braces { }
      • Array: Values separated by commas, all surrounded by square brackets [ ]
      • true
      • false
      • null
      Parameters:
      key - Key of the new JSONObject.
      jsonLine - The JSON string to process (may contain newlines).
      Returns:
      true if the string represents a valid JSON object, false otherwise.
